vendor: Brex LLC (subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.)
product_family: Intelligent Finance platform with AI-powered automation for corporate spend management, including AI agents for expense management, accounting automation, bill pay, cards, and treasury. Marketed as 'Intelligent Finance' with features like Brex Assistant, Audit Agent, and Review Agent.

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Brex is currently SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Brex is currently SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 compliant. System and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2) is viewed as a robust audit of a business that outlines current approaches to security controls.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Brex maintains ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, with certifications available through Brex's Trust Center powered by SafeBase.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: PCI-DSS Compliant. Additionally, Brex maintains PCI Attestation of Compliance documentation, with reports available through the Trust Center.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Brex acknowledges Data Protection Laws including the EU General Data Protection Regulation 2016/679. Each party will separately comply with its obligations under Data Protection Laws when processing personal data. For restricted transfers, the transfer shall be subject to the Standard Contractual Clauses, which are incorporated into and form an integral part of the DPA.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA BAA compliance or certification on Brex domain. Brex offers solutions for healthcare organizations but does not advertise HIPAA compliance as a core offering.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP certification or applicability documented on vendor domain.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 or AI-specific governance certification documented on vendor domain.

privacy.ai_training_note: No public evidence that Brex trains AI models on customer data. Privacy policy does not mention model training. Data Processing Addendum explicitly restricts data use: 'Brex will...not retain, use, or disclose Personal Data for any purpose other than for the specific purposes of performing the Services and to comply with applicable law.' Customers can opt out of marketing communications and interest-based advertising.
privacy.data_region: Global with Standard Contractual Clauses; data may be transferred globally as necessary to provide services in compliance with data protection laws. No specific geographic data residency requirement documented.

flags: Product naming clarity: 'Brex AI' is not a distinct product name in Brex's marketing. The directory entry refers to Brex's Intelligent Finance platform with AI-powered features (expense automation, accounting agents, etc.), not a standalone 'Brex AI' tool. Clarify on listing that this is the Brex platform's AI capabilities, not a separate AI product.

Fintech-focused: Brex is primarily a financial operations and spend management platform, not a pure AI tool. AI features are embedded within the platform (agents, automation) but Brex itself is a fintech solution.
No HIPAA compliance documented: While Brex serves healthcare customers, there is no public evidence of HIPAA BAA or compliance certification.
No AI-governance certs: No evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 or CSA STAR AI certifications, though Brex publishes guidance on AI risk considerations.
